Definition: Mica, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Micha = "who is like God"; 1) son of Mephibosheth; 2) a Levite who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 3) father of Mattaniah, a Gershonite Levite and descendant of Asaph
